sn55.24:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
sn55.24:1.2: tena kho pana samayena sarakāni sakko kālakato hoti.
sn55.24:1.5: tatra sudaṃ sambahulā sakkā saṅgamma samāgamma ujjhāyanti, khīyanti, vipācenti:
sn55.24:1.8: yatra hi nāma sarakāni sakko kālakato,
sn55.24:2.1: atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn55.24:2.5: tatra sudaṃ bhante, sambahulā sakkā saṅgamma samāgamma ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
sn55.24:2.8: yatra hi nāma sarakāni sakko kālakato,
sn55.24:3.1: yo so mahānāma, dīgharattaṃ upāsako buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato, dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato, saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato, so kathaṃ vinipātaṃ gaccheyya.
sn55.24:3.2: yaṃ hi taṃ mahānāma, sammāvadamāno vadeyya,
sn55.24:3.3: dīgharattaṃ upāsako buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato, dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato, saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gatoti, sarakāniṃ sakkaṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
sn55.24:3.4: sarakāni mahānāma, sakko dīgharattaṃ upāsako buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato, dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato, saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato.
sn55.24:4.1: idha mahānāma, ekacco puggalo buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
sn55.24:4.2: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.24:4.5: anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā”ti hāsupañño javanapañño vimuttiyā ca samannāgato.
sn55.24:4.6: so āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
sn55.24:4.7: ayampi kho mahānāma, puggalo parimutto nirayā, parimutto tiracchānayoniyā, parimutto pettivisayā, parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
sn55.24:5.1: idha mahānāma, ekacco puggalo buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
sn55.24:5.2: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.24:5.5: anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā”ti. hāsupañño javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato.
sn55.24:5.6: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti. tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
sn55.24:5.7: ayampi kho mahānāma, puggalo parimutto nirayā, parimutto tiracchānayoniyā, parimutto pettivisayā parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
sn55.24:6.1: idha pana mahānāma, ekacco puggalo buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
sn55.24:6.2: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.24:6.5: na hāsupañño na javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato.
sn55.24:6.6: so tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī hoti, sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti.
sn55.24:6.7: ayampi kho mahānāma, puggalo parimuttā nirayā, parimutto tiracchānayoniyā, parimutto pettivisayā, parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
sn55.24:7.1: idha pana mahānāma, ekacco puggalo buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
sn55.24:7.2: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.24:7.5: na hāsupañño na javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato.
sn55.24:7.6: so tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo.
sn55.24:7.7: ayampi kho mahānāma, puggalo parimutto nirayā, parimutto tiracchānayoniyā, parimutto pettivisayā, parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
sn55.24:8.1: idha pana mahānāma, ekacco puggalo na heva kho buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti.
sn55.24:8.4: na hāsupañño na javanapañño, na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato.
sn55.24:8.7: tathāgatappaveditā cassa dhammā paññāya mattaso nijjhānaṃ khamanti.
sn55.24:8.8: ayampi kho mahānāma puggalo agantā nirayaṃ, agantā tiracchānayoniṃ, agantā pettivisayaṃ, agantā apāyaduggativinipātaṃ.
sn55.24:9.1: idha pana mahānāma, ekacco puggalo na heva kho buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti.
sn55.24:9.4: na hāsupañño na javanapañño, na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato,
sn55.24:9.8: ayampi kho mahānāma, puggalo agantā nirayaṃ, agantā tiracchānayoniṃ, agantā pettivisayaṃ, agantā apāyaduggativinipātaṃ.
sn55.24:9.9: ime cepi mahānāma, mahāsālā subhāsitaṃ dubbhāsitaṃ ājāneyyuṃ, ime cāhaṃ mahāsāle vyākareyyaṃ: “sotāpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā”ti.
sn55.24:9.11: sarakāni mahānāma, sakko maraṇakāle pana sikkhaṃ samādiyīti.
